WORM'S-EYE UP THE SHIN — camera flush against cracked asphalt looking straight up the titan's leg-pillar, ankle armor dominating the lower third, riveted plating receding into impossible perspective overhead, torso dissolving into atmospheric haze, head invisible beyond vertical vanishing point.

FLY-BETWEEN-LEGS — camera hovering at ground level between two colossal leg-columns mid-stride, looking through to a burning city horizon miles away, leg-pillars framing the shot like continent-scale cathedral columns, a fleeing convoy visible between the feet for scale.

KAIJU-STEP-DESCENDING — extreme upward angle as the titan's right foot HAMMERS downward, debris and pulverized concrete erupting outward in a concentric pressure-ring, foot occupying the upper two-thirds of frame, shock-fractures racing toward the camera like spiderweb cracks across a windshield.

AERIAL-ORBIT-AROUND-HEAD — camera locked at titan's skull altitude banking around the cranial silhouette, jaw-line dominating against open stratosphere, an entire metropolitan grid visible thousands of feet below, three escort jets reduced to gnats hovering at cheekbone level for wrenching scale reference.

DWARFED-SKYLINE-ESTABLISHING — kilometer-wide cinematic frame from across a bay, the titan standing in midground with a full skyscraper skyline reaching only to its knee, atmospheric haze layering into blue-gray distance behind it, smoke columns rising from crushed districts far below its waist.

SLOT-CANYON-BETWEEN-BUILDINGS — camera wedged at street level in a four-meter alley between glass towers, the titan's shin visible filling the entire slot of sky above, the impossibly narrow frame against the impossibly vast scale compressing the viewer's chest with immediate vertigo.

CRACKED-PAVEMENT-FOREGROUND — extreme low POV with buckled asphalt and an overturned armored transport filling the foreground edge, the titan mid-stride in midground, its kneecap alone clearing the roofline of a thirty-story office block dwarfed beside it.

HELICOPTER-PASS ALONGSIDE TORSO — camera racing at jet altitude in a tight lateral pass alongside the titan's ribcage plating, torso filling the entire right half of frame from frame-top to frame-bottom, ground infrastructure reduced to a circuit-board texture miles below, horizon curving faintly.

CLIFF-EDGE-VANTAGE — camera at human eye-level on a coastal cliff's crumbling rim, the titan rising from the water below, its waist just clearing the clifftop, upper body and head towering above the viewer's eyeline, the drop behind the camera as vertiginous as the scale ahead.

MID-FALL-CAMERA — POV tumbling in free-fall past the titan's chest, armor plating streaking upward through motion-blur as the camera plummets, ground visible far below through the smear of speed, the titan's torso filling ninety percent of frame like a falling skyscraper seen from inside the collapse.

SCRAPING-CLOUD-LAYER — wide aerial at cloud-deck altitude, the titan's skull and shoulders punching up through the overcast, lower body swallowed entirely by cloud, a pair of attack jets visible banking at the cloud-line reduced to thumb-nail scale against the emerging silhouette.

OVER-THE-SHOULDER-FROM-SOLDIER — tight POV directly behind a single infantryman standing in rubble, helmet and rifle barrel in sharp foreground focus, the titan filling every inch of background sky above him, the human figure occupying three percent of the frame, the rest consumed by machine-god scale.

BENEATH-THE-FALLING-FOOT — camera looking straight up as the titan's foot descends from zenith, sky vanishing section by section as the sole fills the frame, shadow darkening the lens, scale-prover dust and pebbles raining downward past the camera in the final milliseconds before impact.

STREET-LEVEL-WITH-DEBRIS — camera at ankle height with a suspended chunk of falling skyscraper facade frozen in the foreground, the titan mid-step through downtown in midground, its hip-joint alone cresting the height of the intact towers it hasn't yet crushed.

AERIAL-WIDE-WITH-JETS-IN-FOREGROUND — high-altitude establishing shot with a full squadron of strike fighters arrayed in foreground formation, the titan visible in midground at identical altitude, wing-spans dwarfed against the titan's fingernail, ocean and coastline visible far below the entire composition.

WORM'S-EYE-UP-THE-LEG — camera pressed flat against cracked earth, titanium foot-armor dominating the lower third, leg-pillar receding upward through impossible forced-perspective vanishing point, torso dissolving into atmospheric haze, head a barely-visible speck against a white-hot sky.

HELICOPTER-PASS-ALONGSIDE-TORSO — camera mounted on a banking helicopter tracking alongside the titan's ribcage-armor at torso altitude, the titan filling two-thirds of the frame across miles of fuselage-length, ground traffic visible far below reduced to pixel-scale movement.

WORM'S-EYE-UP-THE-SHIN — camera pressed against cracked concrete at the titan's heel, looking straight up the armored leg-pillar, riveted plating receding into brutal perspective toward a torso-mass lost in haze, head invisible, the knee alone fills the upper frame like a collapsing building.
